title: disa ecalcarata
intro: Disa ecalcarata, commonly known as the yellow helmet orchid, is a species of orchid native to South Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Disa ecalcarata include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
